response.sql: WITH patient_averages AS (SELECT p.ID, p.SEX, AVG(l.PT) AS avg_pt, AVG(l.IGA - l.IGM) AS avg_iga_igm FROM Laboratory AS l INNER JOIN Patient AS p ON p.ID = l.ID GROUP BY p.ID, p.SEX), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_iga_igm) AS mean_iga_igm FROM patient_averages) SELECT pa.SEX, AVG(pa.avg_pt) AS avg_patient_pt, AVG(pa.avg_iga_igm) AS avg_patient_iga_igm, AVG(pa.avg_iga_igm / NULLIF(o.mean_iga_igm, 0)) AS avg_ratio_to_overall_mean FROM patient_averages AS pa CROSS JOIN overall AS o GROUP BY pa.SEX;

assumptions.assumption: A record contributes to IGA−IGM only when both values are present. If the overall mean is zero, the ratio is undefined and returned as NULL.
